title: glenniea thorelii
intro: Glenniea thorelii, commonly known as Himalayan boxwood, is a plant species native to the Himalayas. The health benefits of Glenniea thorelii include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine as a bronchodilator, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory and inflammatory conditions. Bioactive constituents of Glenniea thorelii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
